skill.name: burp-suite-testing
skill.description: Guides authorized web application testing with Burp Suite, including proxy setup, request interception, Repeater, Intruder, scanning, and reporting.
skill.summary: Use Burp Suite to intercept, replay, and assess authorized web application traffic.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick and network detections are markdown examples or local Burp proxy references, so they are false positives for local execution or exfiltration. The skill still contains actionable web exploitation workflows, including price manipulation, authentication bypass, credential attacks, and command or file access payloads. Publication should require stronger authorization boundaries and lab-only framing.

remediation.issue: Actionable offensive testing steps can be misused outside authorized assessments.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit refusal guidance for unauthorized targets and require written scope before exploit workflows are used.

remediation.issue: Credential attack and brute-force examples are broadly framed.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict Intruder guidance to approved test accounts, low payload counts, rate limits, and lockout-safe test plans.

remediation.issue: Sensitive file and command injection payloads include password-file examples.
remediation.suggestion: Replace sensitive targets with harmless lab-only placeholders and state that payloads must be used only in controlled labs.

remediation.issue: Exploit examples lack repeated scope checks at the point of use.
remediation.suggestion: Add scope reminders before price manipulation, authentication bypass, command injection, and traversal examples.

content.user_title: Test Web Apps with Burp Suite
content.value_statement: Web teams need a repeatable way to inspect and test application traffic. This skill guides authorized Burp Suite workflows for interception, replay, scanning, and findings review.
actual_capabilities: Explains Burp proxy setup with the local 127.0.0.1:8080 listener.
Guides HTTP request interception, forwarding, modification, and history review.
Shows how to set target scope and filter in-scope traffic.
Describes Repeater workflows for controlled parameter testing.
Outlines Professional scanner setup and issue review steps.
Explains Intruder configuration and result analysis for authorized tests.
limitations: Does not install or operate Burp Suite by itself.
Automated scanning steps require Burp Suite Professional.
Does not verify that a target is authorized for testing.
Examples may require adaptation for each application and environment.

use_cases.title: Validate Staging Traffic
use_cases.description: Inspect requests and responses for a staging application before release.

use_cases.title: Run Authorized Assessments
use_cases.description: Structure manual Burp testing across scope, Repeater, Intruder, and reporting.

use_cases.title: Review Scanner Findings
use_cases.description: Use Burp Professional results as starting points for manual validation.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Burp Proxy
prompt_templates.prompt: I have permission to test a staging web app. Guide me through setting up Burp Suite proxy and browser interception.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect A Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me capture one in-scope HTTP request, review headers and parameters, and decide what to send to Repeater.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Scanner Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an authorized Burp Professional scan plan for my target scope, including scan mode, rate limits, and manual validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Test Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a scoped Burp Suite testing workflow for authentication, access control, and input validation. Include evidence to collect and reporting notes.

output_examples.input: I need to test an authorized checkout flow in staging.
output: Confirm written scope and use a test account.
Capture the checkout request in Proxy.
Record whether server-side validation blocks unsafe values.

output_examples.input: A scan reported a possible reflected script issue.
output: Open the triggering request and response.
Repeat the request with a harmless validation marker.
Compare response behavior and browser execution evidence.
Document impact, affected parameter, and remediation advice.

output_examples.input: Browser traffic is not appearing in Burp.
output: Check that the local listener is active.
Confirm the Burp certificate is trusted for HTTPS.
Review intercept rules and target protocol support.

best_practices: Confirm written authorization before testing any target.
Set target scope before scanning or sending repeated requests.
Validate automated results manually before reporting vulnerabilities.
anti_patterns: Running heavy scans without rate limits or maintenance windows.
Treating scanner output as final evidence without manual review.

faq.question: Do I need Burp Suite installed?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explains workflows, but it does not install or run Burp Suite for you.

faq.question: Can I use Community Edition?
faq.answer: Yes. Proxy and Repeater workflows work in Community Edition. Automated scanning requires Professional.

faq.question: Does this skill confirm authorization?
faq.answer: No. Users must confirm written permission and scope before testing any system.

faq.question: Can it help with HTTPS interception?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains certificate setup at a high level and common troubleshooting checks.

faq.question: What outputs should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect testing steps, traffic review guidance, scan review notes, and report-ready finding summaries.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production targets?
faq.answer: Only with authorization, agreed scope, and rate limits. Use a staging environment when possible.
